$comment: Shared day-rule cases: backend DayPlannerTests (C#) and frontend dayPlan.test.ts (TypeScript) both run every case.
Root: { "$comment": string[], "cases": Case[] }. Case: { name (unique, snake_case), description, input, expected }.
input.protocol: ProtocolDocument (camelCase, as stored in plan_versions.document) or null.
input.protocolActivatedOn (optional): yyyy-MM-dd local date the protocol was activated; anchor of every_n_days items without schedule.anchor (no anchor at all: never scheduled).

input.workouts: [{ planVersionId, activatedAt (ISO instant), activatedOn (yyyy-MM-dd local date of activatedAt), rotation (RotationDto) }], in any order. Active version on a date: greatest activatedOn <= date; tie -> greatest activatedAt.
input.overrides: [{ date, workoutDayKey }] (workoutDayKey "off" = rest day), any order. Semantics = frontend/src/domain/rotation.ts resolveDay.
expected: { dayType: "training"|"off"|"none", workoutDayKey: string|null, targets: Target[] }.
Target: { type: "meal"|"protocol_item"|"cardio"|"workout"|"checkin", key, label, slot: string|null, time: "HH:mm"|null, reminderEnabled }.

Rules: meal -> key = meal.key, label = meal.label or "REF n" (1-based position) when blank, slot meal_<key>. protocol_item -> key = item.key, label = item.name, slot by timing (with_meal:<k> -> meal_<k>; fasting|after_meal|before_bed|pre_workout|intra_workout|post_workout -> same name; any/other -> null).

Item schedule: daily; weekdays (days mon..sun); every_n_days (n, anchor ?? protocolActivatedOn; (date - anchor) mod n == 0); training_days_only (dayType training); off_days_only (dayType off or none). cardio (key "cardio", label "Cardio", slot cardio) when cardio.daily or cardio.sessionsPerWeek > 0.
workout (key "workout", label "Treino <dayKey>", slot workout) on training days. checkin (key "checkin", label "Check-in", slot checkin) every day.
time/reminderEnabled: the slots row matching (slot, dayType of the day; none -> off); no row or null slot -> time null, reminderEnabled false.
Order: time ascending, untimed last; ties by slot (ordinal; null slot last), then key (ordinal), then type (meal, protocol_item, cardio, workout, checkin).

cases.name: sequence_training_day
cases.description: Tue 2026-10-20 is B (index 1). Training times; training_days_only in; weekdays mon/wed/fri out; every 3 days out.

cases.name: sequence_rest_day
cases.description: Wed 2026-10-21 is off (index 2). Off times; off_days_only and wed item in; no workout target.

cases.name: every_n_days_hit
cases.description: Thu 2026-10-22 is C; 3 days after the anchor, so the every_n_days item (after_meal, no slot row: untimed) is in.

cases.name: every_n_days_without_anchor_uses_protocol_activation
cases.description: Anchor missing: counts from protocolActivatedOn (2026-10-17), so 2026-10-20 is a hit for n=3 and n=1.

cases.name: every_n_days_without_any_anchor_is_skipped
cases.description: No anchor and no protocolActivatedOn: the every_n_days item is never scheduled.

cases.name: override_workout_on_rest_day
cases.description: Review Focus 4: 2026-10-21 (natural off) overridden to C: training day, training slot times, pre_workout item in, off_days_only out.

cases.name: override_off_on_training_day
cases.description: Review Focus 4: 2026-10-20 (natural B) overridden to off: off times, no workout, off_days_only in.

cases.name: override_off_postpones_rotation
cases.description: off on 2026-10-20 (B) postpones: 2026-10-21 becomes B instead of the natural off.

cases.name: override_off_on_rest_day_keeps_rotation
cases.description: off on 2026-10-21 (already a rest day) does not shift: 2026-10-22 stays C.

cases.name: override_workout_nearest_occurrence
cases.description: Items A,B,off,A,C,off. A on 2026-10-20 (natural index 1) re-anchors at index 0 (nearest A, not index 3): 2026-10-21 is B.

cases.name: cumulative_overrides
cases.description: C on 2026-10-20 (index 3), then off on 2026-10-22 (natural B, so index 0): 2026-10-23 is B (natural A).

cases.name: overrides_before_active_version_ignored
cases.description: w2 activated 2026-10-22 (same items). The C override on 2026-10-20 belongs to w1 and is ignored: 2026-10-23 is B.

cases.name: same_day_activation_tie_by_activated_at
cases.description: Two versions activated on 2026-10-20, listed out of order: the later activatedAt (w_late, X,Y) wins. 2026-10-21 is Y.

cases.name: rotation_anchor_overrides_activation
cases.description: rotation.anchor 2026-10-17 (before activatedOn 2026-10-19): 2026-10-20 is index 3 = C.

cases.name: fixed_weekdays_training
cases.description: fixed_weekdays: Wed 2026-10-21 maps to B.

cases.name: fixed_weekdays_unmapped_is_off
cases.description: fixed_weekdays: Thu 2026-10-22 is not in the map, so it is a rest day.

cases.name: with_meal_and_untimed_items
cases.description: with_meal:1 joins meal_1; with_meal:9 (no such meal, no row) is untimed in meal_9; any has no slot. Meal 2 label empty -> REF 2. Untimed last, null slot after named slots.

cases.name: no_protocol
cases.description: No protocol: only workout and check-in.

cases.name: no_workout_plan
cases.description: No workout version: day type none, slots use off times, off_days_only in, no workout target.

cases.name: before_first_activation_override_ignored
cases.description: 2026-10-18 is before w1: none, even with a direct override that day.

cases.name: unknown_rotation_type_is_none
cases.description: Rotation type unknown: none.

cases.name: daily_cardio_without_slots
cases.description: cardio.daily, no schedule rows: everything untimed with reminders off, ordered by slot, then key.
